SELECT
  typeof(l."TG") AS triglyceride_type,
  typeof(p."Birthday") AS birthday_type,
  COUNT(*) AS qualifying_lab_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p."ID") AS distinct_patients,
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN p."Birthday" IS NOT NULL AND date(p."Birthday") IS NULL THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END) AS unparseable_birthdays
FROM "Laboratory" AS l
JOIN "Patient" AS p ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE l."TG" >= 200
GROUP BY typeof(l."TG"), typeof(p."Birthday")
